structured.feedback: The description is about 190 words in Markdown with clear subheadings, an active voice and a call to action. Its claims come from the listing and reviews, and it avoids the breakage and weak-hold complaints, links and invented quotes. Minor flaws are the loose feature/benefit split, the "without worrying about easy breakage" claim (listing-based, but reviews undercut it), and the thin "Value" section.
